title: CONFIRMED L2 (forensically complete) — 'advance top 1' turned an Offer-stage candidate with a freshly drafted offer into a Hired with NO offer record, NO candidate comm, NO onboarding, NO sealed decision — and the weekly stats celebrated the phantom hire by name
expected: Hired is outcome-bearing: reached only via extend offer → candidate accepts. The set_stage guard (422) and the [id]-route offer_review branch both enforce it; the command bar should too.
got: Live sequence on own fixture m-cand-013-job-000 (Karolína Hájeková, Offer, score 99, approval_kind=offer_review with a drafted Czech letter at 116 000 CZK): command preview showed only 'Karolína Hájeková · 99% · Senior Java Backend Engineer' — the PreviewRow.stage the API returns is never rendered (CommandBar.tsx:98-104), so not even the stage was visible, let alone the consequence. Confirm → 'Hotovo — zpracováno 1 kandidát.' Aftermath (DB forensics): stage=Hired, approval_kind/detail=NULL (the drafted letter destroyed), offers rows=0, dev_outbox rows=0, decision_records=0, only a pipeline event 'advanced · Command bar: advance top'. Board shows her in Najat/a; the Today rail now reads '3 kandidáti tento týden přijati — Anna Bartošová, Karolína Hájeková +1' and she vanished from 'nabídky u kandidátů'. The candidate believes she has an offer conversation pending; the system says she is hired; nobody was told anything.
evidence: shots/l2-pa-15-advance-done.png + shots/l2-pa-16-board-after-advance.png (Najat/a; rail '3 ... přijati — ... Karolína Hájeková')
DB post-state: stage Hired, approval NULL, offers=0, outbox=0, decision_records=0
scope_note: Sibling of gsim-l2-102 (generic accept path); this is the COMMAND surface variant, reachable by one typed line. Evidence residue deliberately left in DB (m-cand-013-job-000 Hired-without-offer) — see run journal.
suggested_acceptance: advance_top excludes Offer-stage entries (preview says why) or routes offer_review entries through the same extendOffer path; the preview renders each row's stage; Hired is never reachable without an offer record.

title: CONFIRMED L2 on both clients — drag-to-Hired shows the false 'tabule byla obnovena' message, the drawer shows a bare generic; the server's instructive 422 (itself English-only) never reaches the recruiter
expected: The (correct) Hired guard should teach the offer-flow grammar when it refuses.
got: Live board drag onto Najat/a → banner 'Kandidáta se nepodařilo přesunout — tabule byla obnovena.' (nothing concurrent happened; nothing was 'obnoveno'). Drawer 'Změnit fázi' → Najat/a → 'Kandidáta se nepodařilo přesunout.' Raw API response captured: 422 {error:'Hired is set when the candidate accepts an offer, not by a manual move. Move them to Offer and extend an offer.'} — discarded by both clients (PipelineTab.tsx:555-561 catch-all t('moveFailed'); CandidateDrawer.tsx moveStage catch). Note the server sentence is hardcoded English, so even surfacing it verbatim would break the cs workspace — it needs a catalog key.
evidence: raw 422 body captured in run log
suggested_acceptance: The 422 Hired case renders its own localized explanation, distinct from the 409 concurrent-change message; ideally the Hired column signals 'jen přes nabídku' before the drop.

title: NEW L2-only — every candidate letter from the board goes out in ENGLISH for Czech candidates: locale is captured only at apply, so 60/65 entries have locale NULL ⇒ DEFAULT_LOCALE 'en', and the 'correctly locale-resolved' deterministic templates resolve the WRONG locale for nearly the whole funnel
expected: Marek's scored criterion: all candidate-facing messages render correctly in Czech. L1 certified the deterministic templates as locale-resolved (mechanically true).
got: Live: command-bar reject of two Czech candidates produced 'Hi Aneta Veselá, Thank you for your interest in Junior Mobile QA Engineer – George…' (kind rejection, queued) — English subject and body under the bank's name. The drawer's scheduling invite to Roman Malý: 'Pick your interview time… Hi Roman Malý, Good news…' while Petra's drawer simultaneously confirmed in Czech '✓ Odkaz na výběr termínu odeslán kandidátovi'. Cause: commsTranslator(entry.locale) with locale NULL → DEFAULT_LOCALE 'en' (comms-dispatch.ts:39-47, i18n/locales.ts:12); locale is only ever set by the apply flow — board-added, Match-sourced and seeded entries all carry NULL (DB: 60 of 65). Contrast: Tereza (apply, locale cs) got Czech letters. The recruiter-facing UI never shows which language went out.
evidence: dev_outbox rows ref m-cand-011-job-004 / m-cand-014-job-004 (English rejection letters to Czech candidates, captured in run log)
dev_outbox row ref pe-008 (English scheduling invite to Roman Malý) vs shots/l2-pa-11-invite-minted.png (Czech '✓ odesláno' confirmation)
DB: select locale, count(*) from pipeline_entries → NULL:60, cs:3, en:2
suggested_acceptance: Entries get a locale at creation (workspace default, or inferred from the CV/profile with an override in the drawer); the Outbox/drawer letter rows show the letter's language; a cs-workspace board never silently defaults candidate comms to English.

title: NEW L2-only — command-bar mutations never reach the tamper-evident decision chain: the same reject that seals via the board/drawer route leaves ZERO decision_records when typed, while still emailing the candidate
expected: The decision chain (Art.22 dossier posture) seals every human accept/reject — [id]/route.ts:249-260 does exactly this for the board/drawer path.
got: Live-proven on own fixtures: command-bar 'reject below 40 on Mobile QA' rejected m-cand-014-job-004 and dispatched its rejection letter (events: rejected + rejection_sent), yet decision_records for that entry = 0. Command-bar 'advance top 1' hired m-cand-013-job-000 — decision_records = 0. Cause: command/route.ts:80,102 calls actOnPipelineEntry directly and never calls sealDecisionSafe (the seal lives only in the [id] route). A candidate adversely affected via the FASTEST bulk surface has an empty sealed dossier.
evidence: DB: decision_records candidate_ref m-cand-014-job-004 → 0 rows; m-cand-013-job-000 → 0 rows (m-cand-011 gained only the 'reinstated' seal from the API reinstate)
app/api/pipeline/[id]/route.ts:249-260 (the seal the board path gets)
suggested_acceptance: Command-bar accept/reject seal the same decision record as the [id] route (kind advanced/rejected, actor human:recruiter, rationale = the typed command).

title: UPGRADED at L2 (L1 surface-model gap) — for a human/command bulk reject there is NO undo anywhere in the UI: the Decisions 'Znovu zvážit' queue lists only auto_rejected entries, so the reinstate affordance L1 credited is unreachable for exactly the batches Marek fires
expected: L1 recorded 'reinstate exists, per-candidate on Decisions' (minor). Marek's criterion: bulk candidate-facing actions have an undo/recall path.
got: Live: after the command-bar reject of two candidates, the Decisions tab shows NO reconsider section and lists neither candidate (they also vanish from the board — terminal status excluded from listPipeline). Cause: listReconsiderQueue joins pipeline_events on kind='auto_rejected' only (app/_lib/db/pipeline.ts:402-419, comment: 'a manual human reject is a deliberate decision, not a queue item') — but the command bar and board bulk reject record kind 'rejected' (human). The reinstate MACHINERY works and seals: POST {action:'reinstate'} on m-cand-011-job-004 → 200, active@Screened, decision_records kind 'reinstated' — proven live, API-only. Fix landed ≠ fix reachable: for this path it is reachable by curl, not by Marek.
evidence: API reinstate round-trip captured in run log (200 → active@Screened + 'reinstated' seal)
suggested_acceptance: The bulk-reject result line links a batch-scoped 'Obnovit' (or the reconsider queue also lists recent human/command rejects); a rejected candidate is findable somewhere in the UI within one click of the batch that rejected them.

title: CONFIRMED + SHARPENED at L2 (minor→major) — the Czech UI actively TEACHES commands the parser rejects: both of the bar's own example commands ('zamítni všechny pod 60 %', 'posuň první 3') fail with English 'Didn't catch that.' which then re-suggests the same broken Czech examples
expected: A Czech recruiter following the placeholder/examples can run a command, or at least read the failure in Czech.
got: Live: typing the placeholder's own example 'zamítni všechny pod 60 %' → 'Didn't catch that.' + 'Zkuste: „zamítni všechny pod 60 % na backend“…' — an infinite loop of the UI recommending incantations its parser (English-verbs-only, pipeline-command.ts:41-55) cannot parse. L1 rated this minor as 'English-only grammar'; live it is a self-defeating affordance — the documented path fails on first use for every cs user.
suggested_acceptance: Czech verb aliases parse (at minimum the exact strings the placeholder/examples advertise); describeCommand keys through the i18n catalog.

title: NEW L2-only (code cross-check; corrects the L1 walkthrough) — the command bar's done-state silently DISCARDS the route's commsFailed count: a partially-un-notified reject batch reads as a clean 'Hotovo'
expected: L1 credited the command bar with surfacing commsFailed. Marek's question is 'odešlo to? a komu?'.
got: The route returns {count, commsFailed} (command/route.ts:108) but CommandBar's done handler stores only description/count/summary (CommandBar.tsx:35) — commsFailed never renders. In this run commsFailed was 0, so the live path showed nothing wrong; the discard is verified in code. The only trace of a failed rejection comm is the 'rejection_comms_failed' event, which the feed renders as a raw humanized kind.
suggested_acceptance: done-state renders 'z toho X oznámení se nepodařilo odeslat' whenever commsFailed > 0, linking the affected candidates.
